title: DO YOU HAVE AN LIC POLICY? (LIFE IN CHRIST)

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: He who has the Son has life; he who does not have the Son of God does not have life. (1 John 5:12)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Insurance companies in this world offer various types of security accidents, critical illnesses, child upbringing, old-age care, future education, and much more are included in these.
However, all of these only protect worldly life. They emphasize money, regulations, and renewals.
Yet, there is only one true insurance to obtain endless, eternal security, and that is  LIFE IN CHRIST.
Here, no premium is required because Jesus paid for it completely with His blood. This insurance was prepared by Jesus Christ solely for us and our eternal security. We do not need to give anything in return, nor can we. But only one thing is needed: faith.
By faith alone can we acquire this LIC.
If you live in Christ, you are eternally secure. Faith is the only required spiritual permit and approval!
Do you have an LIC Policy (Life In Christ)? If not, get it right now. This world is rushing toward destruction. There is no more time to delay. Jesus is the only way. Do not delay. Enroll yourself today with faith.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "Outside of Christ, I am weak. In Christ, I am strong. Outside of Christ, I am lost. In Christ, I am redeemed." Watchman Nee

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, thank You for the atoning sacrifice You paid to save my life. Today, I place my trust in You and accept You as my LIC Policy. I desire to live in You. Grant me the grace to walk with You in eternal security. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May your life be filled with eternal security and peace in Christ. May your faith keep your eternity secure!

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: Knowing God
recommended_book.author: J.I. Packer
recommended_book.quote: Christianity is not merely an insurance plan, but a relationship with God through Christ, which grants eternal security."
